postCommitReadback.query:
WITH f AS (SELECT 'f341af43-15d0-4177-916a-53a8e1a297fc'::uuid id, 'd8a175f5-51f3-4499-acb9-efc8b7d1b607'::uuid sid), counts AS (
SELECT 'auth_users' scope,count(*) n FROM auth.users,f WHERE users.id=f.id
UNION ALL SELECT 'auth_sessions',count(*) FROM auth.sessions,f WHERE user_id=f.id OR sessions.id=f.sid
UNION ALL SELECT 'auth_refresh_tokens',count(*) FROM auth.refresh_tokens,f WHERE user_id=f.id::text OR session_id=f.sid
UNION ALL SELECT 'auth_password_amr',count(*) FROM auth.mfa_amr_claims,f WHERE session_id=f.sid OR mfa_amr_claims.id='5ff6ebcb-627c-4153-86a4-45e2daff4e62'::uuid
UNION ALL SELECT 'auth_identities',count(*) FROM auth.identities,f WHERE user_id=f.id
UNION ALL SELECT 'profiles',count(*) FROM public.profiles,f WHERE profiles.id=f.id
UNION ALL SELECT 'forum_profile_defaults',count(*) FROM public.forum_profile_settings,f WHERE user_id=f.id
UNION ALL SELECT 'student_roles_and_assignments',count(*) FROM public.user_roles,f WHERE user_id=f.id OR assigned_by=f.id
UNION ALL SELECT 'internal_test_registry',count(*) FROM private.internal_test_accounts,f WHERE user_id=f.id
UNION ALL SELECT 'preserved_auth_audit',count(*) FROM auth.audit_log_entries,f WHERE position(f.id::text IN payload::text)>0
UNION ALL SELECT 'storage_objects',count(*) FROM storage.objects,f WHERE owner=f.id OR owner_id=f.id::text OR position(f.id::text IN name)>0 OR position('dv3study-0eabb144' IN name)>0
UNION ALL SELECT 'storage_buckets',count(*) FROM storage.buckets,f WHERE owner=f.id OR owner_id=f.id::text
UNION ALL SELECT 'storage_multipart_uploads',count(*) FROM storage.s3_multipart_uploads,f WHERE owner_id=f.id::text OR position(f.id::text IN key)>0 OR position('dv3study-0eabb144' IN key)>0
UNION ALL SELECT 'storage_multipart_parts',count(*) FROM storage.s3_multipart_uploads_parts,f WHERE owner_id=f.id::text OR position(f.id::text IN key)>0 OR position('dv3study-0eabb144' IN key)>0
) SELECT jsonb_build_object('checkedAt',clock_timestamp(),'fixtureId','f341af43-15d0-4177-916a-53a8e1a297fc','counts',jsonb_object_agg(scope,n),'allExpectedCountsZero',bool_and(n=0),'oldBearerDenialVerified',false,'immediateLogoutFencingVerified',false) AS exact_reconciliation FROM counts;
